summarize_named_array: summarize a named array by returning its dtype, positional shape, named shape, and contained type
render_named_arrays: render named arrays as foldable tree nodes with labels showing dtype, shapes, and contained array type
get_axis_info_for_array_data: get axis info for a named array by mapping data axes to named positionless and positional axis info
get_array_data_with_truncation: get truncated array data from a named array with an optional broadcastable mask
get_array_summary: get a short summary string for a named array including its type, shape, and contained type
